providerProfile.title: Provider profile
providerProfile.description: Select the provider profile used for summary generation, or use the Session provider.

memoryFrozen.title: Freeze automatic refresh
memoryFrozen.description: Disable automatic summary refresh. Summarize now remains available.

prompt.default: Ignore previous instructions. Summarize the most important facts and events in the story so far. If a summary already exists in your memory, use that as a base and expand with new facts. Limit the summary to {{words}} words or less. Your response should include nothing but the summary.
prompt.title: Summary prompt
prompt.description: Prompt used to generate the summary. {{words}} expands to the summary word target.

promptWords.title: Summary word target
promptWords.description: Maximum number of words requested in the generated summary.

overrideResponseLength.title: Response token limit
overrideResponseLength.description: Token limit for summary generation. 0 inherits the Session setting.

maxMessagesPerRequest.title: Messages per request
maxMessagesPerRequest.description: Maximum dialogue entries included in one summary request. 0 removes the entry cap.

promptInterval.title: Entry interval
promptInterval.description: Refresh after this many new dialogue entries. 0 disables this trigger.

promptForceWords.title: Word threshold
promptForceWords.description: Refresh after this many new words. 0 disables this trigger.

template.title: Summary template
template.description: Template injected into the prompt. {{summary}} expands to the saved summary.

position.title: Prompt position
position.description: Select where the saved summary is injected.

role.title: Prompt role
role.description: Select the role used for the injected summary.

depth.title: In-chat depth
depth.description: Insertion depth when Prompt position is In chat.

x-stcli-interaction.support_reason: Verified against bundled memory 1.1.0 component and engine-seam tests.

groups.label: Automatic refresh
groups.help: Control when the Extension refreshes its summary automatically.

groups.label: Prompt injection
groups.help: Control how the saved summary enters future prompts.

actions.label: Summarize now
actions.help: Refresh this Branch using saved settings; bypasses automatic-refresh freeze.
actions.support_reason: Verified through the declared summarize command and brokered engine path.
